cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:cd.title: Business Development Project Director (BDPD)
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:cd.description: Business Development Project Director This is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) role in Sales and Business Development. Build, implement, train, and evaluate customized business development solutions that support a lead Project Director and an Engagement plan, assisting small to medium-sized businesses (SMBs) in achieving their strategic objectives. Solution implementation will encompass sales team structure and development, business development processes, and sales enabler tools implementation.
responsibilities: Conduct a business development discovery with Cogent clients to understand the Client’s role in the market, previous business development efforts, and organizational revenue goals.

While on-site, build, document, and outline a business development plan that is solely focused on the client and positively impacts their growth goals. This plan should incorporate both short-term actions and long-term behaviors necessary to achieve success in the BITE (Build, Implement, Train, and Execute) methodology.

Identify new issues and opportunities in the client organization. Create tangible and quantifiable change that will address these issues and support material improvement in the client’s business in the following functional areas:
*Generate additional volume of product or service sales
*Enhance margin through improved sales GP
*Diversify customer base
*Enhance client’s liquidity through improvement with terms for client’s customers
*Extend existing customer relationships and sales volume
Collaborate with the Client to clearly define growth goals, human resources available, and sales enabler technology (i.e., CRMs) currently in place.
Manage the body of work to a high quality and on-time delivery, as identified in the “Business Development Plan." Follow the established Cogent Analytics process for client and project engagement.
Review and disseminate information from sales activity reports and apply this analysis to business development improvement on behalf of the client.
qualifications: Ability to travel onsite with clients (75% domestic travel requirement).
Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
Authorized to work in the United States.
Minimum of four years of consulting experience with a proven track record of delivering value for clients.
Administrative duties completed in a timely and accurate manner.
Ability to communicate in English, both written and verbal.
Valid state-issued driver’s license and current auto insurance.
Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Suite, financial software, dashboards, CRM, and PM software)
Proven fiduciary responsibility, successfully managing a budget of 10M+, preferred.
Prior business ownership preferred.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7f34949f-f3a2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff AI Marketing Systems Engineer based in United States. This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role focused on building AI-native systems that transform how Sales and Marketing teams work. You’ll design, build, and operate production-grade agent workflows that surface intelligence, automate content creation, and respond to real-time deal and campaign signals. The role spans LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, agent orchestration, data platforms, and enterprise integrations. You’ll work directly with sellers, marketers, and cross-functional technical teams to understand workflows and turn them into reliable AI-powered products. A major focus will be building systems that are secure, permission-aware, observable, evaluable, and genuinely useful in day-to-day work. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape architecture, product direction, technical standards, and the roadmap from prototype through production. This is an opportunity to help define how AI becomes a trusted operating layer for modern go-to-market organizations. Discover and map Sales and Marketing workflows by working directly with sellers, product marketing managers, and campaign teams to identify inefficiencies, requirements, and opportunities for AI-driven improvement. Define agent runtime and application architecture covering context, state, tools, permissions, retrieval, evaluation, human review, routing, and execution. Design trusted knowledge flows that combine account, persona, product, competitive, and campaign intelligence while managing freshness, conflicting sources, provenance, and source-of-truth decisions. Build routing systems and specialist agents supporting sales asset generation, campaign briefs, competitive intelligence, copy production, account planning, and active deal workflows. Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise Sales and Marketing platforms such as Salesforce, Seismic, Gong, Notion, Snowflake, and Slack, while maintaining appropriate access boundaries. Establish permission-aware retrieval, audit trails, provenance, prompt-injection defenses, retention controls, and clear rules for autonomous versus human-approved actions. Develop evaluation frameworks, regression testing, release checks, and quality guardrails to ensure AI outputs are accurate, relevant, reliable, on-brand, and useful. Continuously evaluate agent performance using seller feedback, usage data, output quality metrics, and representative evaluation sets, improving prompts, retrieval, tools, models, and workflows. Own systems throughout their lifecycle, from rapid prototype through reliable production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and eventual retirement. Track workflow outcomes including time-to-information, content creation effort, editing requirements, adoption, response time, cost per request, citation coverage, source freshness, and output accuracy. Partner closely with Sales leadership, Marketing Operations, Data, Security, IT, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Requirements: 6+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production AI systems that use LLM APIs, tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and agent workflows. Demonstrated experience shipping AI-enabled software that real users depend on, with the ability to explain what was built, how it was evaluated, what failed, and how it was improved. Strong knowledge of agent-system architecture, including agent boundaries, context and state management, permission-aware tools, evaluation, observability, failure handling, and human escalation. Experience with modern AI development tools and frameworks such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, Dust, LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable technologies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:855f40cf-ea8a-.title: Director of Finance & Business Performance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:855f40cf-ea8a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Finance & Business Performance based in Ireland. This is a senior finance leadership role focused on rebuilding and transforming the finance function of a growing multi-location food-service business. You will take ownership of core financial operations while strengthening cash management, payroll, reporting, controls, and compliance. Beyond traditional finance responsibilities, you will turn financial data into practical insights that guide business decisions and improve performance. You will lead budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis, and investment evaluation across locations, brands, channels, and products. The role requires a commercially minded finance leader who can connect financial performance with pricing, operations, and growth decisions. You will also redesign finance structures, systems, and controls to create a more scalable and reliable function. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced finance executive who enjoys building from the ground up and creating lasting organizational impact. Lead the finance function through a hands-on transformation, establishing strong processes, controls, reporting standards, and operating rhythms. Take ownership of core financial operations, ensuring cash, payroll, compliance, and other critical financial responsibilities are properly controlled. Build accurate, timely, and actionable financial reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into business performance. Own annual budgets, rolling forecasts, cash planning, and financial projections, continuously updating assumptions based on business performance. Develop profitability reporting by location, brand, channel, and product to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Analyze unit economics and financial drivers to help leadership understand the factors influencing profitability and sustainable growth. Evaluate pricing, promotions, investments, and strategic initiatives through robust financial models and business cases. Partner with operational and commercial leaders to translate financial insights into practical actions and measurable business improvements. Redesign finance team structures, systems, workflows, and internal controls to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and accountability. Introduce modern finance technologies, AI tools, and automation to streamline reporting, analysis, forecasting, and decision-making. Establish clear financial performance metrics and ensure leadership has timely visibility into risks, opportunities, and key business trends. Develop finance talent and build a sustainable succession plan, including the eventual development of a successor capable of taking ownership of the function. Provide evidence-based financial guidance to senior executives and constructively challenge decisions when financial analysis indicates a different course of action. Requirements Significant senior-level finance leadership experience, ideally with experience operating at CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent level. Demonstrated success improving profitability, financial forecasting, cash management, reporting, and overall finance operations. Strong commercial understanding, including pricing strategy, unit economics, investment analysis, profitability drivers, and business-case development. Advanced, hands-on experience with AI, automation, modern finance technologies, and data-driven financial analysis. Strong accounting and financial management knowledge, with a professional finance or accounting qualification strongly preferred. Experience building or transforming finance functions, particularly in environments where processes and systems require significant improvement. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9e9e368d-734e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer based in United Kingdom. You will play a key role in building and evolving products used by a rapidly expanding global user base. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b6596ba3-0e65-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in Ireland. As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you’ll help build and evolve the storage and query infrastructure behind a large-scale process orchestration platform. You’ll work across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to keep process data reliable, performant, and available. Your work will directly support capabilities ranging from process monitoring to emerging AI-driven automation experiences. You’ll tackle complex challenges around data storage, retention, streaming, secondary storage, and scalability. The role offers strong ownership, with opportunities to shape technical solutions from requirements through production delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, QA, SRE, Support, and fellow engineers in a remote-first environment. It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a sophisticated backend platform while growing your expertise in data-intensive systems. Design, build, and maintain backend services responsible for storing and serving process data across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, reliability, and scalability. Own engineering initiatives end to end, translating product requirements into technical designs, breaking complex work into actionable tasks, and driving delivery to a high standard. Help evolve how process data is processed, retained, exposed, and streamed so customers can access and use their data effectively. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as platform usage grows, while developing tooling that supports observability, troubleshooting, and safe production operations. Investigate and resolve complex data-layer production issues, including slow queries, indexing problems, and execution-plan challenges, as part of L3 support and on-call rotations. Partner with Product Management, Support, SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to ensure technical solutions meet customer needs and production requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement by bringing lessons from production incidents and customer feedback back into engineering practices and product development. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Hands-on experience with at least one major database or search technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch. Practical understanding of query performance, indexing strategies, data modeling, execution plans, and the trade-offs involved in designing data-intensive systems. Demonstrated experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives, including requirements analysis, technical design, task decomposition, implementation, and reliable delivery. Ability to troubleshoot data-related production issues and investigate slow queries, index usage, and other performance bottlenecks. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote-first environment, with the ability to work effectively with Product and engineering stakeholders and provide and receive constructive code-review feedback. Willingness to use and understand the product as part of developing customer-focused solutions. Experience with workflow automation, process orchestration, or developer platforms is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Familiarity with CI pipelines and database migration or schema-evolution tools such as Liquibase or Flyway is beneficial. Benefits: Competitive, transparent, location-based compensation, with the applicable range determined by skills, experience, and location. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:a7ed5a7e-d47.description: エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。 Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,500万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。(2025年現在)2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版、2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、100万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。 2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。 Job Summary: オンラインデーティングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」の高速な開発と品質向上の両立を実現する、テストエンジニアリングの責任者を募集します。 AIエージェントの活用による開発の高速化は、すでに業界全体で一般化しつつあります。 同時に高速化し続ける開発に対して、開発速度を落とさずにどのように継続して品質を担保し続けるか、 はこれまで以上に重要な課題になると考えています。 私たちは現在、自動テストと継続的なフィードバックを開発プロセスに組み込み、変更による影響や品質上の問題を早期に検知できる環境を整えることで、開発者だけでなく、AIエージェントも品質を確認しながら自律的に開発を進められる状態を目指しています。 その実現には、自動テストと継続的なフィードバックを開発プロセスに組み込み、開発者だけでなく、AIエージェントも変更による影響や品質上の問題を早期に検知し、修正につなげられる環境が欠かせません。 また、継続的な改善にはテストカバレッジ、テストの実行状況、不具合の検知率、本番への不具合流出、インシデントの発生状況などを継続的に計測し、開発速度と品質の状態を定量的に把握する事も必要です。 thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Urologic Specialists of Northwest Indiana (USNI) - powered by Urology Alliance. As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), Urologic Specialists of Northwest Indiana (USNI) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers USNI to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Why Highland is the Place to Be: Known as the "Hub of Northwest Indiana," Highland is a bustling suburban center that perfectly blends its role as a regional retail powerhouse with a high-energy center of business and hospitality. It is a place where you can enjoy the quiet, spacious residential pockets in the morning and access some of the best shopping and entertainment in the state by the afternoon. With a town population of approximately 36,000—serving a much larger daily commuting base—Highland is large enough to host major corporate headquarters and regional medical facilities, yet small enough to maintain its identity as a convenient and community-oriented crossroads. Highland Lifestyle: Natural & Historic Beauty: Often celebrated for its accessibility to the Indiana Dunes and local green spaces, the town is home to scenic spots like Hidden Lake Park. It sits on land originally part of the historic Sauk Trail, maintaining its legacy as a vital transit and commerce point. Cultural Roots: As a central gathering point for the Calumet Region, the town hosts diverse community festivals and is home to the legendary Star Plaza Theatre site legacy and the Albanese Candy Factory. It serves as a cultural melting pot where local traditions meet the vibrant influences of nearby Chicago. Strategic Stability: Situated at the intersection of I-65 and US-30, Highland offers the economic resilience of a major commercial corridor paired with the professional innovation of the Purdue Research Park and a thriving hospitality sector. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away.
